summary: This bill creates a new tax credit for businesses that replace or modernize their freight railcars to improve capacity, fuel efficiency, or performance, with a limit of 1,000 railcars per taxpayer per year.

scores.thoughts: This bill introduces a new tax credit, which effectively reduces government revenue and can be considered a form of government spending through the tax code. The credit incentivizes the replacement or modernization of freight railcars.
The core of this bill is the creation of a new 10% tax credit for freight railcar modernization expenses, which will result in lower tax liabilities for eligible businesses.
